headlines.name: MIT discovers that aging weakens the brain’s nighttime cleaning system
headlines.headline: MIT discovers that aging weakens the brain’s nighttime cleaning system
headlines.description: MIT researchers have discovered that the brain’s natural waste-removal system becomes significantly less effective during sleep as people age. The decline is linked to weaker deep-sleep brain waves and changes in blood flow, potentially offering new clues about why aging increases the risk of Alzheimer's disease and dementia.

headlines.name: Thanksgiving dinner will cost more this year, Farm Bureau says
headlines.headline: Thanksgiving dinner will cost more this year, Farm Bureau says
headlines.description: Record turkey prices and higher fuel costs could make Thanksgiving dinner more expensive this year, according to a survey released Wednesday. The American Farm Bureau Federation said the cost of an average Thanksgiving feast for 10 will rise 6% from last year to $58.63. The group tracks grocery prices using hundreds of volunteers in all 50 states and Puerto Rico.

headlines.description: Morgan Chittum here. Nvidia posted quarterly results late Tuesday that handily beat earnings and revenue expectations—just days after Jensen Huang resigned as CEO following reports of extramarital affairs. The upheaval sent the stock to its lowest level in well over a year. The better-than-expected fiscal third quarter may give public-market investors a reprieve.
